metaDescription: Five washer dryer options at or below the $2000 cap, from RV-grade combos to a full-size smart pair, compared on drying speed, capacity and install demands.
expertTake: The Splendide RV combo with its included vent kit is the pick for most buyers at this cap because vented drying and a dual-rotating drum solve the biggest complaint about combos, which is speed. The Samsung Smart 4.7 cu ft pair is the choice when you have a real laundry space and want full-size capacity. Anyone who wants a single drum without a duct should compare the Contoure ventless unit first.
introParagraphs: A cap near the top of the combo market buys something different from a lower one. It does not simply buy a bigger drum, it buys a choice of philosophy: a rugged vented all-in-one built for coaches, a ventless combo that asks nothing of the wall, or a full-size smart pair that drops the one-drum idea entirely.

Each answer solves a different problem, so the best pick depends on your space, your plumbing and how you actually do laundry. Prices move, and the $2000 cap reflects listing prices at the time this guide was updated, so confirm the live price before you buy, and remember that the listing can include or exclude vent kits, cords and delivery in ways that change the true cost of getting the machine running.

products.name: Splendide 15 lb vented washer dryer combo for RV with complete vent kit
products.description:
Splendide's RV combo is the pick because it attacks the biggest weakness of one-drum machines: slow drying. Vented drying pushes moist air outside instead of condensing it, which is much faster, and the complete vent kit in the box removes the first installation headache. A dual-rotating drum helps reduce wrinkles, and variable spin speeds let you tune extraction to the fabric.

The capacity is modest at 15 lb, which suits one person or a couple and keeps the machine compact enough for an RV closet. The listing says it can wash, dry or go straight from wash to dry with no laundry transfer, which is the true one-drum convenience.

Vented drying needs a duct path and a safe exhaust location, so confirm that before ordering. Keep the duct short and straight, clean the lint screen after each load and check the vent cap each season. In a coach, secure the machine with the maker's hardware before every move. Variable spin speeds are worth learning: use the lowest for delicates, a middle setting for everyday cotton and the highest for towels, since a lower water content going into the dry phase is the cheapest way to save time. Given the automatic wash-to-dry transition, load the drum to no more than about two thirds so clothes can tumble, and do not stuff towels in with delicates or the dry phase will leave the heavier items damp.
products.bestFor: RV and small-home owners who can run a duct and want faster drying.
pros: Vented drying is faster than condensing

products.name: Samsung Smart 4.7 cu ft top-load washer and 7.4 cu ft electric dryer pair

specList.label: Bundle
specList.value: Cords, hose set and 8 ft vent duct

products.description:
This is not a one-drum combo but a full-size smart pair, and it is included because at this cap many buyers realize two good machines beat one compromised one. The washer is a 4.7 cu ft top-loader with Active WaterJet and vibration reduction, the dryer a 7.4 cu ft electric model with a sensor that stops drying to prevent over-drying, and both connect through the SmartThings app.

The bundle includes 3-prong and 4-prong dryer cords, a washer hose set and an 8 foot vent duct, so installation is far smoother than with bare machines. The pair needs a laundry room, a dryer outlet and a vent, so it is out of reach for a studio closet.

If your home can take it, this pair outperforms every combo here on capacity and drying speed. Place it where the Wi-Fi reaches, clean the lint screen each load and have the vent inspected yearly. The smart layer is optional, but the notification when a cycle ends is the feature most owners keep using, because it stops damp clothes sitting and souring. If you move the pair later, keep the original bundle parts, since the cords and duct are tailored to the install. Check that the floor can take the washer's wet weight and that the dryer outlet matches the cord you pick. In an older home, an electrician can confirm that the dryer circuit is the right size and in good condition, which is far cheaper than discovering a problem after the machines are connected. Keep the owner's manual and the app login in one folder so the next person has them.
products.bestFor: Homes with a laundry space that want full-size capacity and remote alerts.
pros: Full-size 4.7 cu ft and 7.4 cu ft drums
cons: Needs a laundry room, outlet and vent

products.name: Contoure 2.7 cu ft ventless washer dryer combo with steam 120V
products.description:
Contoure is the answer when you want one drum and cannot run a duct. The 2.7 cu ft ventless combo runs on 120V, includes a steam function and is designed for both RV and residential installs, so it fits a coach closet as easily as a home laundry nook.

Ventless condensing is slower than the Splendide's venting, and the dry load is smaller than the wash load. In exchange, the machine needs only water, power and a drain, which makes it the easiest to install in an apartment.

Use steam to refresh clothes and keep loads to about two thirds of the wash capacity for drying. Wipe the door seal, leave the door ajar and run a clean cycle monthly. Because this is the machine that goes where a duct cannot, give it the best airflow you can around the cabinet, and keep the water supply steady, since the condenser relies on cool water to turn vapor back into liquid. Run a small test load first to learn how long a full dry takes in your home, then plan laundry nights around that number instead of the cycle display.
products.bestFor: One-drum buyers who cannot run a duct.
pros: Designed for RV and residential use
cons: Dry load smaller than wash load

products.name: Splendide WDV2200XCD vented washer dryer combo white
products.description:
The WDV2200XCD is a long-running Splendide combo with vented drying. The listing is short, giving a 155 lb shipping weight and a 33.2 by 23.5 by 23.5 inch package, so most of what we can say is from its type and its history in RVs.

Its selling point is familiarity: technicians know it, and parts and manuals are easy to find. Its limit is information, since the listing does not state capacity, voltage or cycle count, so confirm those details with the seller.

Plan the duct and the water hookups carefully, keep the lint screen clean and inspect hoses regularly. Treat it as the safe, familiar option rather than a feature-rich one. Older combos are best bought with a clear return window and a full inspection on arrival: run a wash, a spin and a dry cycle, check the door seal and the drain for leaks and listen for bearing noise. If you are buying one that has been installed before, ask for the vent route and the water hookup details, because a combo moved between coaches often needs new fittings.
products.bestFor: Owners who want a familiar vented RV combo with easy service.

products.name: Auertech 28 lb washer with 2.8 cu ft portable dryer and boot dryer
products.description:
This portable pair is the budget end of the cap and shows what you can do without any permanent install. A 28 lb fully automatic washer with ten cycles and a built-in drain pump pairs with a 2.8 cu ft portable dryer that has a boot dryer function.

The pair is two machines and two chores, and the dryer is smaller than the washer can fill. It does not match the Samsung's capacity or the Splendide's vented speed, but it needs no duct and rolls out of a closet.

Use it for weekly laundry and keep an eye on exhaust and lint. Clean the drain filter, keep the hose clipped and place it on a level floor. The portable dryer should sit where warm moist air can leave the room, and the pair is happiest with a window kit or a short hose to an opening. Since the washer is larger than the dryer, run the washer first on a long spin, then split a big load into two dry batches, and use the cool-down mode for knits so they do not shrink.
products.bestFor: Renters who want a no-install pair at the low end of this cap.
pros: 28 lb washer with a drain pump
cons: Dryer smaller than the washer can fill
Two machines to place and plug in

buyingCriteria.criterion: Why drying speed is the real cost
buyingCriteria.explanation: One-drum ventless combos cost less in space but cost more in time, often two to four hours per load. Vented designs like the Splendide dry far faster by sending moist air outside. At this cap you can afford speed, so decide whether your home can take a duct. A short rigid duct to an exterior wall costs far less than most buyers expect, and in many homes a window vent kit is a workable stopgap. Rental buyers should ask the landlord about venting before ordering, and anyone planning a coach install should look at where the exhaust will exit the body of the vehicle.

The Splendide RV combo lists 15 lb, the Contoure 2.7 cu ft and the Samsung pair 4.7 and 7.4 cu ft. The Westland listing gives no capacity at all. Always find the dry capacity, since it limits real use more than the wash number does.

The combos save floor and effort, while the Samsung pair gives full-size capacity and fast drying. If you have a laundry room, two machines are usually the better product, because a washer and dryer can run in parallel and each is tuned for its own job. A washer drum that only washes can spin faster and agitate harder than a combo drum that must also tumble dry, and a dryer built only to dry moves far more air. The price of that advantage is floor space and two sets of hookups, which is why combos exist in the first place. If you have a closet, a combo is the only choice.

The Splendide includes a vent kit and the Samsung pair includes cords, hoses and a vent duct. A missing kit can add cost and delay. Count what is in the box when you compare tiers. A 4-prong dryer cord, an 8 foot vent duct and a hose set might add up to a meaningful amount at the hardware store, and getting the wrong cord for your outlet can delay installation by days. List the parts you will need for each option and add them to the price in your head before you decide which tier is really cheaper.
Combos for coaches must tolerate vibration and run on 120V. The Splendide and Contoure are aimed at that use. A full-size pair does not belong in a coach.

A long-running model like the Splendide WDV2200XCD has plenty of technicians and parts. Newer machines may have better warranties. Check both before you commit, especially if you live on the road. Ask about the warranty terms for labor and for travel use, since some makers void coverage for mobile installs. A simple spares kit with a door gasket, a drain pump and an inlet hose set costs little compared with a week without a washer in a remote campground.

cards.label: Combo
cards.text: The Splendide and Contoure save floor space and effort. They are slower and carry less per load.

cards.label: Full-size pair
cards.text: The Samsung pair gives far more capacity and faster drying. It needs a laundry room, an outlet and a vent.

howToChoose.note: Choose a combo for closets and coaches, a pair for homes with space.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: 120V operation, a vent kit or a ventless design and a way to secure the machine. Check weight and cabinet size against your closet.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: Both Splendide models and the Contoure suit coaches. The Samsung pair does not, and the Auertech pair suits small trailers.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want faster drying or full-size capacity. The Splendide RV combo and the Samsung pair deliver.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You can accept slower drying. The Contoure or the Auertech pair is cheaper.

faq.q: What is the best washer dryer combo at this price?
faq.a: The Splendide RV combo is the best fit for owners who can vent, and the Contoure is best for those who cannot. If you have space, the Samsung pair beats both on capacity. Choose by installation.

Live prices shift, but the Auertech pair and Contoure sit lower and the Splendide models and the Samsung pair higher. Budget for ducting and delivery. A cheaper unit that needs extra parts may cost the same in the end.

faq.q: Is vented drying worth it in an RV?
faq.a: It dries much faster, and the Splendide includes a vent kit. You need a safe exhaust location. If you cannot vent, a ventless unit like the Contoure works.

faq.q: Can a full-size pair fit in a small home?
faq.a: Only with a laundry room, a dryer outlet and a vent. The Samsung pair needs all three. A closet calls for a combo.

faq.q: Why does the Westland listing have so little detail?
faq.a: It is an older model with a brief listing. Confirm capacity, voltage and venting with the seller before buying.

faq.q: How do I prepare an RV combo for travel?
faq.a: Drain the drum, secure it with the maker's hardware and check fittings after trips. A loose combo can damage plumbing and floors.
